name: Hosah
overview: The name Hosah appears in Scripture as both a geographical location and a person. It is identified as a city within the territory of the tribe of Asher, situated along the coastal boundary near Tyre and Achzib, highlighting its significance in the tribal allotments of Israel. Additionally, Hosah is the name of a Levite from the family of Merari, noted for his leadership role among his sons, emphasizing the organized structure and responsibilities within the Levitical families. These references together illustrate the multifaceted use of Hosah in the biblical narrative, reflecting both God's provision of land for His people and the established order within His appointed servants.
